notes: One row per rule that went live DURING the cm18 run, in order; `stage` is the chain stage whose code (or input file) it changed, `live` the moment the live file was replaced (rules_applied.py tests each box's stage start against it). Rules live before the run began (2026-11-05 ~22:30) are in every box and are not listed.

rules.what: shoreface: a void ringed by a measured bed under the base is the sea's gap in that bed (the multibeam lattice)
fill: the guard's cone gives way to a measured bed beside the cell (gaps between surveys filled at -45 m off Bluff Point)
joint: inside a vintage zone, beds, water and casts older than the zone's survey are no evidence for the sea-sheet rule (the Woz delta front)
shoreface: any void leaves a bed-ringed void's ring whole (Halibut Cove Lagoon's lattice)
water: a lake only the prior saw takes the low decile of the measured ground at its edge when that stands >= 0.5 m over the prior's level (the r3c2 lakes)

tide_vectors islands: 3DEP land the high-tide polygons never cut out (Perl, Elizabeth, the east Chugach island, 5,666 ha at the bay's head, 154 ha) is no mapped water -- tide_sea.geojson 18:01, the ArcticDEM tide clip 18:03 (read by the joint), water_3dep rebuilt at the chain's start

joint writes layer_flown.tif (a lidar's return of any class, a non-derived grid's cell, the layer's water) and the recipes' 3DEP fallback footprint reads it, not layer_class (ArcticDEM gaps were 'flown' and the prior withdrawn: Perl Island carved)

joint: a speck or a floating component at the survey's own water level with a cast >= 2 m below within 150 m is the sea, dense or sparse (Anchor Point's Kenai 2008 strays); zone-aware except under lone returns

fill: a tidal-lens cell whose shallowest cast within 150 m stands >= 2 m under the observed water surface is water over a bed -- the floor path, the surface its ceiling (Anchor Point: the bed had been modelled at Kenai 2008's 1.9 m surface in 6 m of water)
fill: the contour shore model runs for a floor-path sea with no land rim in the box (open-water boxes: the casts' basin spline instead of a flat at the low-tide floor)

build: a cell a points source (the soundings unit) contributed to keeps the rules' take at full weight -- never despeckled, never feathered (upper Grewingk Lake's lone soundings fell to the layer beneath)
build rules: a prior's (3DEP's hydroflattened) water surface is no ceiling on later beds and evicts nothing (Grewingk's shallow soundings stood above the 41.3 m flat and lost their cell)

fill: a lone observed cell's value holds halfway to the next observation (<= 20 m) instead of a one-cell cusp; a lake's soundings fitted at chi 0.2 like the sea's casts (upper Grewingk's sparse soundings)

rocks.py + tide_vectors.py review: Hig's review source 1 (rocks typed high/mid/low/sub as floors against the source's water level, estimated -1.75 m; 36 new, 29 ENC activated, 30 moved; 4 low + 2 high lines Point Adam - Port Graham)
joint units: Homer 2019 and 2021 NCMP green lidar (ground + bed, no shift: +0.02 / -0.04 m vs Homer 2018) -- the beach vintage zone lets the newest hold the bars

shoreface: the basin prior reaches past its fine kernels (coarse cascade sigma 0.5-8 km, nearest beyond) instead of reading 0 and taking the base contour > 2 km from casts (the band at 59.24903,-152.27016)
shoreface: no land rim in the grid -> the rim's extension is the deep side of the base (open-water boxes r5c0-r7c0 were 208 km2 of intertidal, 0 sea)
shore: a routed level never stands > 1 m under measured ground (r6c3/r6c4 channel at 59.63708,-151.15933)
fill: the domain split keeps a lake level the rim rule set (Petrof Lake 12.04 m was dropped: river domain, channel model, pits at the soundings)

fill: within 6 m of an observed cell a modelled wet cell (band/interior/conditioned/margin/intertidal) is the harmonic through the observations round it, fading to the model's fill by 25 m (multibeam swath gaps, rings round multibeam holes: Halibut Cove Lagoon grooves and wall mesas, Coal Cove mesas, the 59.358 trough, Homer flat lines)

joint: a lidar's flat sheet within the tide's reach (robust flatness: within stand_flat_m of its 5x5 median, level under 1 %) standing > 4 m over the shallowest compilation on half its cells is the sea, with the pocks it encloses (Kenai 2008's flight lines at +2.5/+3.8 m off Anchor Point, 59.69273/59.72965)
fill: the gap fit pins only to observed patches of >= 25 cells (no cones round a stray return in open water)
joint: a sea sheet that slopes (> 0.15 %, >= 1 ha, rising >= 1 m) is a tidal flat; of a level one only the cells at its water's level go (Woz)
joint: ground in the mapped low-tide water > low tide + 1 m, off every mapped rock, over a measured bed/cast or seen sparsely, is the sea (Anchor Point)
joint: compilations yield under a lidar's sea surface with nothing measured below, within 6 m of it (Kasitsna)
joint: level pieces ringed by a deeper measured bed are the sea (spikes, Chugachmiut mesas)
fill: tidal flats in true gaps take a low-gradient trend + harmonic of the observations, raise only (Seldovia head)
fill: modelled bed in the mapped low-tide water held at its level
fill: the tidal-flat fit capped by the plain harmonic of the observations round the gap

tide lines: low water past the high polygon's closing edges stands whole, no inset seam along them, its low line kept (Anchor Point sand bar 59.76788,-151.86990; 83 km of false low-water closures gone)

a lidar's small deep patch (<= 4 cells, > 15 m under every other source, above 6 m) dropped before the date rule (Homer 2019 pits over Kenai 2008, 59.70416,-151.42943; ~1,200 in r6c1 r6c2 r6c3 r7c2 r7c3)

a sounded lake's basin: the profile to the soundings' Dmax plus one tension surface through them with the shore, then the 2 m spline (Petrof's cones gone; misfit p90 1-1.7 m in Petrof, Grewingk, the Hazels)

3DEP's exact-0 sea no ground in the fill prior; good casts under the intertidal contour stay intertidal; KBay specks at a sea sheet's stand over a compilation 1 m below (Kasitsna partly: -0.09 -> -0.41 m; Anchor Point beach-toe humps gone)
recipes read soundings_edited.csv; Grewingk's 2017 ice-face stretch >30 m off a straight face is ordinary soundings (55)
joint: derived ground (Chugachmiut's DTM) below 0 m over a bed beyond the lowest tide and > 3 m under it yields (Seldovia strip 59.42358,-151.87706)
fill: casts older than their vintage zone's survey are no evidence (joint's zone_day.tif; needs the joint rerun too)
fill: the low-tide cap leaves a river's or tidal body's own water > 0.5 m above low tide alone (Woz delta basin 59.54998,-151.38389)
joint + recipes: change kbay2023 - bathy2009 measured inside kbay2023's vintage zones, graded over the multibeam to 0 at 120 m (the Woz front's 7 m step)
joint: derived ground (ArcticDEM, Chugachmiut) yields where a lidar saw water, within 0.3 m of that water or above it (upper-bay flats, r7c4)

fill + shoreface: on low-angle surfaces (slope < 1 % over 20 m, >= 5 ha, grown 250 m into gaps) no traced tide lines/polygons/low-tide cap; 3DEP ground in their gaps unless at/above a lidar's water (Grewingk Creek delta)
change taper only from overlap patches with median change >= 0.5 m, smooth field (selhead streaks); low-angle 3DEP not inside vintage zones (Woz delta)

fill: modelled beds under seen water (river/tidal/perched/sloped/ephemeral; sea on low-angle surfaces) 0.15 m under the water's smoothed lower envelope, fill_mask 10 = upper bound; replaces channel resolving there (Woz delta)
fill: the water sheet never raises a soundings-conditioned bed (fill_mask 3), only lowers one above the seen water
fill: river/sloped bodies take the lidar's own surface, blurred (6 m), pinned to the banks, 0.3 m under it 10 m in, fill_mask 11; nothing else fills them (Woz delta)
shore: levelless water inside a trusted lake polygon takes its rim's level (p10 of ground within 6 m outside) rather than becoming no water
joint: returns with no ground/water/bed near sea-level water or bed (30 m) are a structure over water: water at the local level
composite: a lower layer not fully compatible with the class-now is withdrawn where a higher layer shows (and the feather underlay)
highline: a measured bed is protected from the tide lines like lidar
fill: marine soundings are stale in water above the highest tide
water edits: Hig's Homer Spit puddles dmax 0.1 m at their 2023 levels
shore: a lake sounding under a prior's flat patch makes the patch water at the nearest level
fill/shoreface: the ground prior never stands in a lake/perched lagoon/pond the lidar saw (or within 10 m)
fill water sheet: a measured bed under the level pulls the sheet down around it
fill water sheet: no taper toward water-surface returns (the pits between them); sheetbed near the sheet
joint layer: small ground ringed by a deep measured bed (boats, floats) is water at the local level, off mapped rocks
composite: post-processing never extends a layer onto a class the class-now rules out; coverage guard restores the rules' winner first

joint: own_sheet_any_water off by default (41 ha of level ground round Homer went to water under cm21; the reservoir is held by Hig's hand-placed depths through the sparse-bed rule). Boxes run under cm21 with it on: r5c2 r4c1 r2c2 r4c5 r6c2

solve (s3): closed island lines of tide_lines.geojson are prior land; no low bound in still water (the 30 m shelf inside Beluga's and the reservoir's shore); AMG coarse solver falls back to splu (r7c4's failed tile); closed basins with no datum raised in the plain solve; a deep modelled patch with no datum is no prior; the low bound smoothed on its high side

solve (s3), Hig's review of 2026-11-20 (Halibut Cove Lagoon, Petrof Beach): the still-water shore ring and the lake profile's shore are cells that are NOT WATER (body lines in open water were held at the level); a confident gridded bed is fixed to its edge (striped multibeam was soft everywhere); a compilation's pull fades within 30 m of a measured bed; sea casts within 15 m of a measured bed are left to it; the deep pass keeps the product within 32 m of a layer's cell (solve_box); the low bound is retired (low_bound_m 0); unmeasured land within 15 m of a traced high-tide line gives way and the line is held at its level, a break of slope. Lines: tide_vectors.py rescue restored 12 dropped straight high-tide edges (2.16 km; chains of r1c1 r1c2 r2c1 r2c4 r3c4 r4c5 hold one). Every s3 solve before this moment was redone.
